value.rationale: A natural inverse nonequilibrium statistical-mechanics problem asks which exactly Gaussian stationary states can be fabricated by randomized instantaneous refreshing, rather than simply computing moments from given refresh laws. The result supplies a complete continuous matrix feasibility classification, a unique realizable law, explicit singular boundaries, and a sharp discontinuous expansion of attainable displacement means at r=dk when output variance is tunable. This is a structural reachable-set and design result, not a parameter substitution or recomputation of a forward moment. It distinguishes Gaussian one-time data from non-Gaussian reset mechanisms, and provides a temporal covariance diagnostic. Physical costs, noisy inference, and other reset protocols remain outside scope.
